_comment: Mudallisin and their tier per Ibn Hajr, Ta'rif Ahl al-Taqdis bi-Maratib al-Mawsufin bi-l-Tadlis (طبقات المدلسين). Tier 1: rare tadlis; 2: tolerated (accepted in the Sahih); 3: accepted only with explicit hearing; 4: also weak/tadlis from weak narrators; 5: weak for other reasons. 'names' are matched against Narrators.FullName/KnownAs after Arabic normalization; 'itqanId' wins when present.
